Dive into the wild, chaotic world of Bogo Sort! 🤪 Also known as 'stupid sort' or 'perverse sort', this algorithm is a masterclass in *how not to sort*. We'll visualize its hilariously inefficient process and question the very nature of sorting. Will it sort our tiny list? Probably not in our lifetime! 😂
